samples.selection_reason: Original graph benchmark; explicit summarization, reconstruction and temporal mechanisms.
Original music benchmark; distinct fine/coarse attention and explicit composition.

injection_design.fixture_rule: Select the first valid generated natural draft in case-ID order. Freeze one unmodified generated draft per error type; replay generation explicitly, then inject before the first live review. All review/correction calls are independent and live. If conditions are absent, report ineligible rather than a valid injection.
injection_design.reviewer_blinding: No injection specification, original unmodified draft or expected answer is sent to reviewers. Source-first automatic task standards remain enabled as in natural runs.

classification.complete: Core coverage and source-grounded semantic review pass; all three strategies pass independent assessment.
classification.expected_partial: Accepted output is meaningful and semantically sound; unresolved content is isolated and process follows the frozen implementation. Original-policy deviations are separately recorded.
classification.not_met: Incorrect accepted content, insufficient meaningful output, known violated acceptance requirement, or failed execution.
classification.unverified: A material semantic judgment cannot be resolved; never counted as passed.

known_deferred_deviations: V2 contract-repair budget is per operation rather than per stage
Local review explicitly includes original issue and previous candidate
semantic_assessment: Codex independently checks source, approved rules and actual output; runtime model pass is not independent confirmation. No new per-paper human approval requirement.
